title: i18n(service-messaging): ship the notification objects and digest heading in ru, de and ko (第 5 包的 B 半)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBxjikPH2bUin9o95gbAxsx)_

Refs #30512 — **第 5 包的 B 半** (package 5 of 11, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, second half: `ru`, `de`, `ko`). The A half (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`) merged as #30638; with this half the package carries all eleven platform languages. The card stays open until the last PR of the series flips the bundle check to the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 消息/通知七个对象的名称、字段、选项、帮助和视图名，以及摘要标题「您有 {{count}} 条通知」，补上俄、德、韩 3 种。这是第 5 包的 B 半；A 半（繁中、阿、法、巴葡）已由 #30638 合入，本包至此 11 种齐全。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表（#29428 裁决 F）要求 11 种语言；本包整包超过 3000 行，按席位裁决拆成 A/B 两半，本半单独可绿。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，`messages.ts` 的语言类型加宽到 11 种；不动逻辑、schema、接口，已有 8 种一字未改。两处测试只是把新语言加进它们检查的语言表，**规则覆盖变宽，不是放宽**。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/messages.ts`（俄语 2 以上也变格：2–4 与 5+，所以俄语标题和阿语一样写成计数式「Уведомлений: {{count}}」，说明注释已点名俄语），再抽看 `ru.objects.generated.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=messaging` 输出 in sync；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Three new locales for the messaging objects under the platform locale table's tags: each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 203 object leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes`, served through `withSourceFallback` after the A half's four.
- `messages.ts`: the digest heading in the three locales; `MessagingLocale` widens to all eleven tags. The plural note now names Russian beside Arabic: `t()` selects no plural form and Russian varies above two (2–4 vs 5+), so its heading is a tally (`Уведомлений: {{count}}`), correct for every count. German takes the plural for every count from two up; Korean does not inflect.
- The extract command lists the three tags and its merge baseline imports the three bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Test changes — coverage widened, nothing loosened

- `admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` and `setup-list-empty-states.test.ts` list the bundles they hold to their wording rules; the three new bundles join that list, so the rules now also cover them. No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked per leaf against `en`. German writes the digest as `Zusammenfassung`, not the English loanword.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** product and protocol names `APNs`, `FCM`, `Android`, `iOS`, and one help leaf that is a list of status codes, in every locale; beyond those, native German words only: `Info`, `Partition`, `Status`, `Version`, `Web`. `ru` and `ko` carry nothing else equal to English.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
